content.text: [structured-output-enforce] You MUST call the StructuredOutput tool to complete this request. Call this tool now.

candidates.explanation: The exclusion filter is `id: Not(Number(conditions.userId))`. It compares the session id with the user id instead of `conditions.excludeSessionId`. So the current session is not protected and is soft-deleted, and its next refresh returns 401. A different session whose id happens to equal the user id is the one that survives. That matches the 'unrelated older session sometimes survives' symptom.

This is the Mongo counterpart. Its body is truncated in the snippet, so I couldn't check it. It could make the same mistake of excluding by userId instead of excludeSessionId. This is a secondary suspect.

fix.description: In deleteByUserIdWithExclude, change the exclusion to use the session id: `id: Not(Number(conditions.excludeSessionId))`. Keep the `user: { id: Number(conditions.userId) }` filter. Check that the document repository excludes `conditions.excludeSessionId` as well.
